facts.text: Practitioner formats for executive communication include Minto's Pyramid Principle with a situation-complication-question-answer opening, military bottom line up front (Army Regulation 25-50), Amazon's six-page narrative and PR/FAQ, the UK Treasury Five Case Model, and Strategic Decisions Group's Decision Quality.
facts.quote: The practitioner formats are Minto's Pyramid Principle and its situation-complication-question-answer opening, the military "bottom line up front" (Army Regulation 25-50), Amazon's six-page narrative and PR/FAQ

facts.text: A McKinsey survey of 1,048 business decisions found that decision process explained more variance in outcomes than quality of analysis.
facts.quote: A McKinsey survey of 1,048 business decisions found that decision process explained more of the variance in outcomes than the quality of analysis [191].

facts.text: Direct controlled evidence that six-page narratives, BLUF or pyramid structures increase technical programme approval or success was not found; these formats are practitioner practices.

facts.text: The first two pages of the plan should answer, in order: the decision requested; why now; what will exist by the deadline; what will not exist; probability or confidence; principal risks; fallback; and resources and decisions needed from leadership.
